categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Injet Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial power supply equipment and new energy vehicle charging piles/stations. Its main product lines include power control power supplies, special power supplies, and electric vehicle charging equipment. The company serves industries such as photovoltaic, semiconductor and electronic materials, steel metallurgy, glass fiber, and scientific research institutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages power electronics technology, including MOSFET, thyristors, and IGBT devices, combined with intelligent digital control circuits for its power control products. It develops modular, programmable power supplies and special power supplies with high precision, stability, and protection features. Manufacturing involves customized design, in-house processing, assembly, and integration, supported by advanced testing platforms and CNAS certification efforts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial users in photovoltaic material production (polysilicon, monocrystalline silicon, battery cells), semiconductor and electronic materials manufacturing, new energy vehicle charging infrastructure operators, steel and glass fiber industries, and scientific research institutions such as nuclear and aerospace research centers. The company also serves overseas markets in Europe, Asia, and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Sichuan Province, China, with operations and R&D centers in Deyang, Chengdu, and Shenzhen. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in the UK and Singapore, and its products are sold domestically and internationally, including Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Injet Electric operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of industrial power supply equipment and charging modules. It supplies critical power control systems and modules to equipment manufacturers in photovoltaic, semiconductor, and new energy vehicle sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with strong R&D investment, focusing on power electronics, semiconductor equipment power supplies, new energy vehicle charging technology, and integrated energy solutions including hydrogen production and storage. It aims to enhance product quality, reliability, and expand into high-end applications through multi-site coordinated R&D and advanced testing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized industrial power supply products, special power supplies, and electric vehicle charging piles/stations. The company operates primarily on a direct sales model with some agency channels for standard products. It also receives government subsidies and investment income contributing to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic industrial power supply manufacturer with strong competitiveness in power control and special power supplies. It competes with other domestic and international suppliers in photovoltaic, semiconductor, and new energy vehicle charging sectors, leveraging its technology platform and diversified industry applications to maintain market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.78 billion, a slight increase of 0.59% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 322.76 million, down 25.19%. It has shown steady growth in semiconductor and electronic materials sectors, while photovoltaic sector revenue declined due to industry downturn. The company maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 4 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sichuan Injet Electric emphasizes high-precision, stable, and customizable power supply solutions with advanced digital control and modular designs. Its products offer superior performance in harsh industrial environments, supporting diverse applications from photovoltaic material production to semiconductor manufacturing and new energy vehicle charging. The company’s integrated technology platforms and strong R&D capabilities enable rapid response to customer needs and continuous innovation, differentiating it in competitive markets.
